data.title: Arpichaya in lead at Portland LPGA event
data.description: PORTLAND, Oregon - Thailand’s Arpichaya Yubol, ​in search of ⁠her first ⁠LPGA tournament win, holds ​a one-shot lead midway through the Standard Portland Classic.

data.title: Thailand, Wada seek closer cooperation
data.description: Thailand is working to strengthen its anti-doping system in line with international standards and deepen cooperation with the World Anti-Doping Agency (Wada).

data.title: Dreams, drama and dread: 72 clubs begin the promotion battle
data.description: <p>Although the Premier League does not kick off until next week, the English football season really gets under way this weekend as the 72 clubs in the Championship, League One and League Two begin their new campaigns. We've already had the opening round of the Carabao League Cup, which, probably, served as a useful warm up for managers and players alike.</p>

data.title: Lions stand in War Elephants' way
data.description: <p>Seven-time champions Thailand will take on Singapore in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday night in a clash between two nations that boast a combined 11 regional titles in the tournament's 30-year history.</p>

data.title: Premier League club Liverpool sell minority stake to Jeff Bezos consortium
data.description: LONDON - Liverpool's owners have agreed to sell a minority stake in the Premier League club to a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nabil Anane launches Thailand Olympic boxing bid – but must earn LA28 spot
data.description: ONE Championship will support Nabil Anane’s attempt to earn a place in Thailand’s boxing team for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics – but the promotion’s former bantamweight Muay Thai champion will not be fast-tracked into the national squad.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nontachai ruled out with illness as Nabati fight is scrapped
data.description: Kiamran Nabati’s ONE Fight Night 46 bout with Nontachai Jitmuangnon was scrapped on Thursday after the Thai fell ill, went to hospital and did not receive medical clearance.

data.title: Hunt bags Euro sprint double, Ceh keeps discus title
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Briton Amy Hunt claimed a memorable European sprint double after scorching to victory in the 200m in Birmingham on Thursday on a night when Germany claimed five medals, including two golds.

data.title: Fit Patrik ready to fire War Elephants
data.description: Thailand head coach Anthony Hudson welcomed the addition of striker Patrik Gustavsson, saying the BG Pathum United star will give the team an attacking option in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-finals on Saturday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati reveals dengue scare before first loss, wants Yod-IQ rematch for title
data.description: Kiamran Nabati wants Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri to dethrone ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai king Rambolek – and give him the chance to avenge his first career defeat with the title at stake.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo tells Tom Keogh ‘back of the line’ after title call-out
data.description: Nico Carrillo has dismissed rising Irish prospect Tom Keogh as “another dreamer” and told him to go to the “back of the line” after his ONE Championship title call-out.

data.title: Messi returns but Miami knocked out of Leagues Cup
data.description: MIAMI - Lionel Messi made an emotional return on Wednesday following his father’s death and hints at retirement, but it wasn’t enough for his Inter Miami side who were knocked out of the Leagues Cup in a 3-2 loss to Mexico’s Leon.

data.title: Grieving Messi unsure about playing on 'much longer'
data.description: BUENOS AIRES - Lionel Messi said he has "serious doubts" about continuing to play football for "much longer" after the death of his father Jorge, in an emotional tribute posted on social media Wednesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo fires back at Superbon – ‘he talks too much’
data.description: Nico Carrillo has questioned why Superbon keeps criticising him as talk grows of a champion-versus-champion fight in ONE Championship.

data.title: PSG down Aston Villa to retain Uefa Super Cup
data.description: SALZBURG, Austria - Champions League winners Paris Saint-Germain rubber-stamped their status as Europe's top team as they beat Aston Villa 2-1 in the Uefa Super Cup on Wednesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Dmitrii Kovtun replaces injured Elbrus Osmanov at Fight Night 46, source says
data.description: Dmitrii Kovtun will replace injured compatriot Elbrus Osmanov against Denis Souza Jr at ONE Fight Night 46 this weekend, a source told the Bangkok Post on Wednesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Superlek vows to repay Chatri’s faith after successful ACL surgery
data.description: Superlek Kiatmoo9 has vowed to repay the faith shown in him by ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong after undergoing successful surgery on his torn ACL.

data.title: Player: Little man with a big influence
data.description: The Piccadilly World Matchplay was held each year at Wentworth and l went to watch whenever l possibly could, which meant occasionally skipping school. This was the first time l saw Gary Player play on the course which he dominated, as he won the event five times. He was a small man in stature, but this was made up for by his determination to be one of the best who practised like a man possessed. His 'never give up' attitude was infuriating for the vast majority of his opponents -- not least for Tony Lema in 1965 who lost against Player when he was 7-up at one stage in his match with the little man.

data.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-term partner Georgina Rodriguez
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Cristiano Ronaldo and his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez married on Tuesday in a ceremony in the Portuguese resort of Cascais, said the football superstar's representatives.

data.title: Tentoglou claims fourth Euro long jump title, injured Jacobs falters
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Greece's Miltiadis Tentoglou soared out to a record-equalling fourth European long jump title in Birmingham on Tuesday, but Italian Marcell Jacobs was unable to claim a third 100m gold.

data.title: Thailand wary of Singapore threat
data.description: Thailand goalkeeper Kampon Phathomakkakul has warned his team not to underestimate Singapore as the two sides prepare to meet in the first leg of the Asean Hyundai Cup semi-final this weekend.

data.title: Trump says would be 'terrible mistake' to oust embattled Infantino
data.description: WASHINGTON — United States President Donald Trump said on Monday it would be "a terrible mistake" to replace Gianni Infantino, the embattled Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president who tried, and failed, to sell off part of the World Cup to private investors.

data.title: What next for beleaguered Fifa president Infantino?
data.description: PARIS — Embattled Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president Gianni Infantino's hope that a combative statement condemning "a concerted and ongoing effort" to undermine him would spark a period of reflection were dashed on Monday.

data.title: Sensational Ingebrigtsen back with more European gold
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Jakob Ingebrigtsen sealed a sensational comeback from achilles tendon surgery to win a record-extending seventh European championship gold in Birmingham on Monday.

data.title: Buriram extend winning run with Ratchaburi victory
data.description: Defending Thai League 1 champions Buriram United maintained their strong pre‑season form with a 2‑0 victory over Ratchaburi in a warm‑up fixture at Ratchaburi Stadium on Sunday night.

data.title: Ingebrigtsen delivers masterclass for seventh European athletics gold
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Jakob Ingebrigtsen consolidated his place as the most successful male athlete in European history on Monday when he won the 5,000m in Birmingham for his seventh individual continental gold.

data.title: Amazon founder Bezos nears deal to buy stake in Liverpool
data.description: BENGALURU - A consortium ⁠that ⁠includes Amazon founder ​Jeff Bezos is close to agreeing a deal ​to acquire a stake ‌of about one-third in Premier League club Liverpool, multiple media outlets reported on Monday.

data.title: Embattled Infantino target of letter from three confederations
data.description: LAUSANNE — Fédération Internationale de Football Association (Fifa) president Gianni Infantino came under renewed fire on Monday as a joint letter from three confederations -- Union of European Football Associations (Uefa), Central America and Caribbean Association Football (Concacaf) and Asian Football Confederation (AFC) -- declared football "belongs to no individual".

data.title: Lionel Messi bids farewell to father who guided his glittering career
data.description: ROSARIO, Argentina - Argentina football icon Lionel Messi bid farewell on Sunday to his father Jorge, the global star's emotional anchor and agent since childhood who passed away following a battle with cancer aged 68.

data.title: Thai siblings strike gold, silver
data.description: Thailand's BMX riders delivered a statement of intent for the forthcoming Asian Games in Nagoya, with the Nakpaen brothers claiming gold and silver at the Asian Championships in Malaysia.

data.title: Chinese duo deny Aimsaard sisters Korea Masters glory
data.description: Women's doubles pair Benyapa Aimsaard and Nuntakarn Aimsaard missed out on their first title since July last year after losing in the final of the US$250,000 BWF Korea Masters on Sunday.

data.title: Spikers keep clean record in second leg
data.description: Thailand finished the second leg of the 2026 SEA V Cup in Chiang Mai with a perfect record after defeating Southeast Asian rivals Vietnam 3-0 (25-20, 25-10, 25-15) on Sunday.

data.title: War Elephants top the charts
data.description: Thailand secured top spot in Group B of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday, beating Myanmar 2-0 in Bangkok to book a semi-final meeting with four-time champions Singapore.
